segments.an4.118:1.1: “Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyāni saṃvejanīyāni ṭhānāni.
segments.an4.118:1.3: ‘Idha tathāgato jāto’ti, bhikkhave, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
segments.an4.118:1.4: ‘Idha tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho’ti, bhikkhave, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
segments.an4.118:1.5: ‘Idha tathāgato anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattesī’ti, bhikkhave, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
segments.an4.118:1.6: ‘Idha tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbuto’ti, bhikkhave, saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
segments.an4.118:1.7: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyāni saṃvejanīyāni ṭhānānī”ti.

lines: 118-120. Aṭṭhame saddhassāti buddhādīsu pasannacittassa vattasampannassa, yassa pāto vuṭṭhāya cetiyaṅgaṇavattādīni sabbavattāni katāneva paññāyanti.
Abhijātiṭṭhānādīnipi tassa uppattihetūni bhavantīti sikkhāpento āha “saṃvegajanakānī”ti.
